title: Dispatch CTW 5: Old Timetable Identifies the Eastbound Train
summary: The message once failed to reach a signalman in time.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: The 1891 inquiry into the Hollow Junction fire mentions an eastbound goods train held outside the station. Its signalman never received the order to proceed after the fire. He waited until morning, avoiding a damaged bridge that would not be inspected until dawn.

Dr. Saye thinks the chorus is still trying to send the hold order, not predict a present accident. Yet tonight’s eastbound train is due to pass the same bridge. Railway inspectors have closed it for examination before the service departs.
